changelog: Added VLC-style video size and aspect-ratio fixing system in the mobile player: Best Fit, Fit Screen (Crop), Fill (Stretch), 16:9 Cinema, 4:3 Classic, 21:9 Ultrawide, Fit Horizontal, and Fit Vertical, with one-tap Fit cycling, long-press full picker, 2-finger pinch-to-zoom, and per-device saved preference.
Upgraded ICC FTP quick-sync to automatically crawl all 28 ICC categories on devices upgrading from Basic Mode, plus hardened ICC poster URL sanitization and count parsing.
Includes silent background auto-sync, direct in-system APK update downloads, VLC-style brightness and 200% sound boost sliders, and full back-button navigation.
